en: This postcard features a collage of colorized photographs depicting various landmarks and locations in the city of Sundsvall, Sweden. The images are labeled in Swedish as follows: Vängåvan (a public park/square), Stora Torget (the main square), Kyrkan (the church), Turisthytdan (the tourist cabin/viewpoint), Tivoli (amusement park or public gathering space), Hamnen (the harbor), Allm. läroverket för gossar (the general upper secondary school for boys), Elementarskolan för flickor (elementary school for girls). The word 'SUNDSVALL' is boldly printed beneath the images. The back of the postcard contains handwritten text in French and English, multiple postmarks, and addresses, indicating it was mailed.
